method: Factual tables transcribed from text extracted from the official City of Vancouver SOFI PDFs linked by the City's financial-reports index. Names and printed amounts are retained; footnote markers are stored separately from names and footnote explanations are paraphrased. Source hyphens are zero; no unstated numeric cells were found in these tables. PDF page numbers are physical, one-based page positions. No original-file hash or visual inspection is asserted.

rounding.reason: The standalone SOFI and its official council-packet edition publish identical whole-dollar cells and totals. The remuneration rows sum to $308,469 versus $308,471 printed, and local expenses sum to $21,074 versus $21,072 printed. Both $2 differences are consistent with independent whole-dollar rounding; original amounts are preserved.
